paite: Jehu kum sagih alal kum in Joash alal pan hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmli alal a; anu min Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba khomi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Joash / (2 Kro 24.1-16)

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in Joash asinsak sung teng TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Himahleh mun sang teng hihsiat vek ahi tuan kei a; mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in gimlim ahal nilouh lai uhi.
Joash in siampute kiang ah, "TOUPA inn a laklut thilzek tatna sum teng simsate lak a pai peuhmahte ahinna uh tatna sumte, kuapeuh in TOUPA inn a laklut aphal uh sum tengtengte,
siampute'n ameltheihte ua pan la uhenla; inn sia, asiatna na bawl uhen," achi hi.
Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Joash bel kum sawmnih-le-thum alal nung in leng siampute'n inn sia abawl kei lailai uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa Joash in siampu Jehoiada leh siampu dangte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a inn siatna bawl lou na hi ua? Tu'n zaw na sumkemte a pan dangka la nawn kei unla, inn sia bawlna ding in pekhe zawta un," achi hi.
Siampute'n mite a pan dangka lak nawn louh leh inn siatna puahphat louh pha asa uhi.

Himahleh siampu Jehoiada in bawm ala a, asin gei avutvang a, TOUPA inn lutna taklam pang, maitam kiang ah atung hi. Huai bawm ah TOUPA inn a dangka tawilut tengteng kongkhak vengmi siampute'n ana koih zel uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, bawm ah dangka atamta chih atheih un, TOUPA' inn ah kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu lianpen ava hoh ua, sumte asim ua ipte ah athun khe zel uhi.
Adangka sim uh nasem mite, TOUPA inn lam mite tung a heutute khut ah apekhia ua; amau TOUPA' inn lam mite leh khutsiam mite;
suangsek mite leh suang laikhe mite kiang ah, TOUPA inn siatna bawlna ding sing leh suangte leh inn bawlna, akhawkna peuh a zat ding in apekhia uhi.

Himahleh TOUPA insung a dangka ahon tawi un, TOUPA' inn a ding dangkasik noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, pengkulte, dangka-eng tui-um belsuante, dangkasik tui-um belsuante abawl kei uhi.
Nasem mite ape zel ua, TOUPA' inn bawlna in azang uhi.
Nasem mite piak dia dangka akepsak mite uh leng a-etzui pih tuan kei uh. Amau ginomtak in ahih zel uhi.
Mohna thoihna dia thillat dangka leh khelhna thoihna dia thillat dangkate bel TOUPA' inn ah alalut kei ua; siampute tantuam ahi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael in Gath khua ava sual a, ala a; Hazael in Jerusalem a hoh atum hi.

Judah kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa apu Jehoshaphat, Jehoram leh Ahaziah in ana latsa thilzek tengteng leh amah thilzekte leh TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng om tengteng ala vek a, Siria kumpipa Hazael akhak a; huchi in Jerusalem apawtsanta hi.
Huchi in Joash tanchin dangte, athilhihte tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Asikhate athou ua, aguk in asim sawm ua, Joash bel Silla zot sukna lampi Millo inn ah asual ua; athatta uhi.
Amah Simeath tapa Jozakar leh Shomer tapa Jehozabadte'n athat ua; huchi in api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Amaziah ahong lalta hi.
